sources.entry: OmniTools - Collection of powerful web-based tools for everyday tasks (coding, manipulating images/videos, PDFs or crunching numbers...). (Source Code) MIT Docker
OmniTools | Self-hosted web-based Swiss army knife for everyday tasks.

summary.one_liner: OmniTools is a self-hosted web app bundling many small online utilities for images, video, PDFs, text, dates, math, and data, with all processing done in the browser.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a collection of web tools for everyday tasks: image, video, and audio tools (resizer, converter, editor, video trimmer, video reverser), PDF tools (splitter, merger, editor), text and list tools (case converters, list shuffler, text formatters), date and time tools (date calculators, time zone converters), math tools (prime number generation, voltage/current/resistance calculation), and data tools (JSON, CSV, XML). The README states that all files are processed entirely on the client side and never leave the user's device. It is distributed as a Docker image, which the README says is about 28MB. The project is a React and TypeScript app using Material UI, with icons from Iconify. The README also documents scripts for creating new tools, running unit and e2e tests, and managing translations through Locize.
use_cases: trim or reverse video in the browser
split or merge PDF files privately
format, case-convert, or shuffle text lists
convert or inspect JSON, CSV, or XML data
notable: All file processing happens client-side; files are not uploaded to a server, per the README
Docker image stated to be about 28MB
Wide range of tools in one app, covering media, PDF, text, date, math, and data tasks
Includes a script to scaffold new tools into folder structures
Translations managed via Locize with partial coverage for ten languages
caveats: Translation coverage is incomplete; several languages are around 67% translated according to the README table
The README lists many tools only as 'and more...', so the full tool set is not enumerated
Contributing requires a Node.js and npm development setup
